title: From the conference floor: four talks worth your time
intro: Notes from three days of sessions, coffee queues and one genuinely surprising poster.

add_content_to_page.add_paragraph: The theme this year was measurement under uncertainty, which produced an unusually practical programme: fewer grand frameworks, more people showing the exact place their method breaks.

items_of_the_timeline.timeline_item_text: A full session on the unglamorous work of keeping instruments comparable.
Two talks on publishing raw series; one on the cost of reorganising them.
The best poster of the meeting: a tray that halved core breakage.
